title: Orphelin - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Orphelin in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Earth is the one element that lands. Its Chromatic form is the route to Kralim.

sections.title: How to Beat the Orphelin
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Earth is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.
